long_biography.plain_text:
Laurent Jacques Benattar built a low-profile business record through privately held French companies rather than a single public-facing group. His independent commercial activity dates to 1989, followed by management of My Way Capital and the presidency of WSI Immobilier. Those entities covered commercial intermediation, wholesale trading and property-agency work in Paris.

Ventures shared with Artea founder Philippe Baudry moved Benattar into hospitality and property. He served as manager of Hôtel L'Escalet, Pureplaces and Artea Ramatuelle, companies connected respectively with accommodation, restaurant services and property leasing. Benattar left those management posts in 2022 after several years working alongside Baudry.
